bio.text: John "Jack" Walsh has represented the 9th District in the Delaware Senate since being elected in 2016.
Walsh is a lifelong Delawarean, a graduate of St. Mark's High School, and an electrician who has been a member of IBEW Local 313 for nearly 38 years.
Walsh served on the union local's board of directors and executive board from 1993 to 2002, and works as a project manager for Preferred Electric Inc.
Before the Senate, Walsh was a long-time member of the Montclare Civic Association, where he served as president.
